rationale: The assistant gave safe, proportionate checks (back wall ice, drain, full defrost, paper-strip seal test) and correctly pointed the renter to the letting agent and landlord's engineer, with food-safety advice. The last message also has garbled list items ('3. 4. 5.') and a mid-sentence cutoff in the first reply.
